messages.lingguang.link.label: Link
messages.lingguang.page.title: Lingguang

messages.lingguang.cap.content-create.description: Create a blank Lingguang note for a workflow to fill in.
messages.lingguang.cap.content-create.title: Create blank handoff note
messages.lingguang.cap.content-list.description: List all Lingguang notes available to pick and pass along in workflows. Read-only.
messages.lingguang.cap.content-list.title: List handoff notes
messages.lingguang.cap.content-read.description: Read an existing Lingguang note so later workflow steps can use its content. Read-only.
messages.lingguang.cap.content-read.title: Read handoff note
messages.lingguang.cap.content-receive.descriptio: Save content handed off from a workflow into Lingguang.
messages.lingguang.cap.content-receive.title: Receive handoff content
messages.lingguang.cap.conversation-get.descripti: Read a Lingguang conversation in this project along with its linked notes and message history. Read-only.
messages.lingguang.cap.conversation-get.title: Read note conversation
messages.lingguang.cap.conversation-message.descr: Generate a reply using a text model based on the selected Lingguang notes and conversation history. If it fails, your conversation stays intact with no placeholder reply.
messages.lingguang.cap.conversation-message.title: Reply in note conversation
messages.lingguang.cap.conversation-open.descript: Start a new conversation or reopen the existing history for selected Lingguang notes. Doesn’t call an AI model.
messages.lingguang.cap.conversation-open.title: Open note conversation
messages.lingguang.cap.create.description: Save a new Lingguang note in this project. Retrying the exact same request returns the original note; reusing a request key with different content is rejected.
messages.lingguang.cap.create.title: Save Lingguang note
messages.lingguang.cap.discard.description: Move selected Lingguang notes out of the active list while keeping their records. Checking last-read timestamps prevents discarding recent edits — if any note changed, none are discarded.
messages.lingguang.cap.discard.title: Discard Lingguang notes
messages.lingguang.cap.fragment-offers.descriptio: Prepare a ready-to-save Lingguang note from selected text without saving it automatically.
messages.lingguang.cap.fragment-offers.title: Prepare note from selection
messages.lingguang.cap.get.description: Read a single Lingguang note in this project, including discarded records. Read-only.
messages.lingguang.cap.get.title: Read Lingguang note
messages.lingguang.cap.list.description: Read all active Lingguang notes in this project. Read-only.
messages.lingguang.cap.list.title: List Lingguang notes
messages.lingguang.cap.material-read.description: Extract text from an uploaded file, including image recognition and audio or video transcription, without saving a note. Asks your permission first if a local recognition model needs to be downloaded.
messages.lingguang.cap.material-read.title: Read uploaded file
messages.lingguang.cap.placement-export.title: Read a note to carry
messages.lingguang.cap.placement-export.descripti: Reads one note so it can be carried to another place (the personal space or a project).
messages.lingguang.cap.placement-put.title: Place a carried note
messages.lingguang.cap.placement-put.description: Places a note brought from another place here: a move keeps it the same one, a copy makes a new one.
messages.lingguang.cap.placement-remove.title: Remove a moved note
messages.lingguang.cap.placement-remove.descripti: Removes a note from here after it moved elsewhere, only while it is still the version that was carried.
messages.lingguang.cap.revert.description: Undo a newly saved Lingguang note by removing it from the list while keeping the record. If it was edited elsewhere after saving, the undo is rejected and nothing changes.
messages.lingguang.cap.revert.title: Undo saved note
messages.lingguang.cap.search-entries.description: List all searchable Lingguang notes in versioned pages so search can build and update its index. Read-only.
messages.lingguang.cap.search-entries.title: List searchable Lingguang notes
messages.lingguang.cap.source-read.description: Extract text from a public web page, video captions, or podcast audio without saving a note, while respecting the source’s access boundaries.
messages.lingguang.cap.source-read.title: Read link content
messages.lingguang.cap.subject-read.description: Read a Lingguang note’s current text, version, and links for accurate reference. Read-only.
messages.lingguang.cap.subject-read.title: Read note content and links
messages.lingguang.cap.update.description: Edit a Lingguang note in this project. Passing the last-read timestamp prevents overwriting newer edits made elsewhere.
messages.lingguang.cap.update.title: Edit Lingguang note
messages.lingguang.permission.lingguang-read.reas: Read your Lingguang notes, links, and conversation history in this project
messages.lingguang.permission.lingguang-write.rea: Create, edit, move, copy, or discard Lingguang notes and save conversations
messages.lingguang.permission.materials-fetch.rea: Read text from public web pages, video captions, or podcast audio you share
messages.lingguang.permission.materials-read.reas: Extract text from files, images, audio, and video you upload
messages.lingguang.permission.model-invoke.reason: Use your configured text model to generate replies about selected Lingguang notes
messages.lingguang.permission.storage-private.rea: Store your Lingguang notes and conversation history locally
